nodes.text:
No need to panic over HMPV—it's not a 'new COVID.' HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) has been around since 2001 and primarily causes mild respiratory infections, especially in children and older adults. Good hygiene & care are key. Stay informed, not fearful. 
#HMPvirus #HMPV
